title: Surface Rust and Python Tests in VSCode Test Editor
description: All compose tests must appear in the VSCode test editor. Go, Playwright, Vitest and F# already show up. Rust (cargo tests in compose/rs/lib.rs) and Python (pytest tests in compose/py/main.py and compose/engine/main.py) are missing. Fix .vscode/settings.json and any configuration so rust-analyzer Test Explorer surfaces the Rust tests and the Python extension discovers the pytest tests.
summary:
Implemented auth and sharable links for server and sketchpad.

Server (compose/server/bin.rs):
- Added AccessMode enum (Owner/Viewer), ShareTokenId newtype
- Added Unauthorized/Forbidden error variants with 401/403 HTTP status
- Added owner_token column to runtime.session table
- Added runtime.share_token table for sharable links
- create_session() now returns owner_token UUID
- Added auth persistence: load_owner_token, create/resolve/list/delete_share_token, resolve_access
- Mutation endpoints (domain commands, compose commands, compact) require Owner access via bearer token
- Read endpoints work without token (viewer mode)
- New endpoints: POST/GET /sessions/{id}/shares, DELETE /sessions/{id}/shares/{token}, GET /shares/{token}
- All 83 tests pass including 2 new E2E tests (e2e_auth_forbidden_without_token, e2e_share_token_flow)

Sketchpad (compose/sketchpad/index.tsx):
- Added ResolvedShareToken and ShareTokenEntry interfaces
- SessionKitStoreConfig: added authToken and readOnly fields
- SessionKitStore: added authToken property, readOnly flag, authHeaders() helper
- create() captures owner_token from session creation response
- All fetch calls send Authorization bearer header when authToken is set
- Read-only guards on apply, replace, undo, redo, sendKitDiffToServer, compactHistory, createShare, deleteShare
- getSnapshot() returns actual readOnly state
- Auth region: getAuthToken(), createShare(), listShares(), deleteShare()
- Static methods: resolveShare(), createFromShareToken() for opening share links
